description:
Chatlaw_Datasets
	

This repository contains two uploaded components:

Chatlaw Datasets: the training subset used for our experiments.
National Unified Legal Examination: the National Unified Legal Professional Qualification Examination (司法考试) dataset.

These files are provided to support dataset organization and downstream processing/training.
reputation: A domain-specific dataset used in Chinese legal-NLP and exam-preparation research with limited broader community adoption.
